title: toona ciliata var. pubescens
intro: Toona ciliata var. pubescens, commonly known as the woolly-toona, is a variety of the Toona ciliata tree, native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing fever, inflammation, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Toona ciliata var. pubescens include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
